_note: Style library. Only styles with ready=true and the active niche (NICHE in .env or the 'niche' command) may be chosen. Each has a skill file with its rules.

styles.name: Flat Explainer
styles.look: clean vector objects, people and icons, smooth morphs, generous space
styles.fits: how-to, services, finance basics, health tips, product explainers

styles.name: Paper Cutout Storybook
styles.look: layered cut paper with soft drop shadows, torn edges, props that pop in
styles.fits: lessons, stories, habits, kids, values, gentle motivation

styles.name: Editorial Magazine

styles.fits: news, opinion, business, economics, analysis, biographies

styles.name: Isometric World
styles.look: small isometric scenes that build up

styles.name: Sketchnote
styles.look: marker lines that draw themselves, doodles

styles.name: Technical Drawing
styles.look: line drawings that construct themselves on light paper

styles.name: Documentary Collage
styles.look: framed or torn-paper collage, map lines

styles.name: Kinetic Type Minimal
styles.look: big words moving with the voice, lots of space
